spatial_rule.note: H0 is an inventory screen. It does not claim the full field polygon lies inside a mapped magazine.

guardrails: No new 0-100 score is created in H0.
SGU mapped withdrawal opportunity is hydrogeological screening, not a legal right to withdraw water.
Representative-point intersection is a field screening relation, not a full polygon-overlap statement.
Multiple vertically stacked magazines at one point are preserved as separate matches.
Unknown/not-assessed withdrawal classes remain unknown and are never imputed.
Large-magazine information does not overwrite the frozen small-magazine or historical drought components.
